_comment: All three abilities were STATIC, which maps to no event and therefore never ran at all -- so even the unconditional Intimidate and Go again did nothing. Card is an action, so its keywords apply when it is played. ROLL_5_OR_6 was set by nothing; roll() now records the die faces. 'Instead intimidate twice' means one extra intimidate on top of the base one, not a second full copy of the ability.
